note: Large forested area along the North Fabius River north of Lewistown, with 48-acre Deer Ridge Lake, about 20 miles of hiking, biking and horse trails, wetland pools and a shooting range. The area map marks primitive camping at about eight spots: the lake camp by the boat ramp on the east shore of Deer Ridge Lake, a horse camp with tie-ups, restrooms and trailer parking near the trails, more spots in the main tract, and four along the county roads in the north tract. No hookups or water; quiet hours 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Spot length is not published. --Claude

Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period. Quiet hours are from 10:00 p.m. to 6 a.m.' Imagery: the lake camp spot is a gravel road shoulder beside an open lawn and the gravel boat-ramp lot (GIS lot 2064, ~50 x 40 m), with a gravel pullout (lot 2911) 70 m NW; a 23-ft rig fits. Camp F is a gravel loop ~60 x 90 m. No ford or 4WD wording.

HORSE CAMP (criteria note, not the pin): the area page says 'Horse campground is the place horseback riders will want to camp. Horse camp offers places to tie up horses, restrooms and space for parking your trailer. From Horse campground is quick access to several of the favorite trails.' Neither the map nor the brochure labels which camp it is; on imagery camp F (GIS 314, 40.1944,-91.8209), a gravel loop with privy and accessible symbols where the trails converge, looks like it. The entry is not on it once re-pointed to the lake camp.

WATERFRONT (Lake camp; stored not waterfront, kept): Deer Ridge Lake is 48 acres (area page). Measured on the 0.91 m/px frame, camping point 273 is ~110 m from the shoreline, with the gravel road, an open lawn and the boat-ramp parking lot between; point 638 is farther back in the trees. The only open ground to the water is the ramp lot and lawn (day use), so not on-water. A view of the lake across the lawn and ramp lot may exist, but no MDC photo of the camp shows it, so it stays not waterfront (unsure goes down).
